description: The file defines the 'FieldsMetaData' class, which models metadata for custom fields within the SuiteCRM application. It includes properties representing database columns, schema details, and methods for deleting records, retrieving list view data, and generating summary text. The class extends 'SugarBean', indicating integration with the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: FieldsMetaData
classes.description: Represents metadata for custom fields in SuiteCRM, providing database interactions and UI data handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class and disables row-level security.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes a metadata record from the database by ID and deletes associated relationships.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for list view, including translated labels and edit links.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the 'name' property as the summary text for the record.
